en.description: Independent monthly ranking of residential, ISP, and datacenter proxy providers tested for connection speed, ASN diversity, and transparent pay-as-you-go pricing.
en.methodologyNote: Each provider is tested monthly across 1,000 target requests in US, EU, and SEA regions. Scores weight connection speed & success rate (35%), real price per GB without forced commitments (30%), IP pool cleanliness & ethical sourcing (20%), and dashboard clarity & support (15%). Note: All 6 proxy providers below carry verified partner affiliate links (/go/ marked rel="sponsored") and reader coupon codes; referral commissions never alter rank order or scores.
en.monthlySummary: November 2026 update: Decodo (formerly Smartproxy) moved to #1 on value after dropping pay-as-you-go rates to $2.20/GB, while Oxylabs holds the highest raw success rate on protected targets.
buyingGuide: Choose rotating residential proxies when scraping localized search results or e-commerce catalogs where each request needs a fresh household ASN. Choose static ISP proxies when managing persistent accounts (paired with an anti-detect browser like AnyProfile) where changing IP addresses triggers security checks.

Watch out for expiration traps: several budget providers advertise low per-gigabyte prices but expire unused traffic after 30 days. For intermittent workloads, a slightly higher pay-as-you-go rate with non-expiring traffic costs less over a quarter.

faqs.q: Which proxy type is best for multi-accounting in AnyProfile?
faqs.a: Static ISP proxies are the safest choice for long-lived profiles because each profile keeps the same residential-registered IP address across sessions without rotating mid-login.

faqs.q: Why isn't the highest-commission proxy ranked #1?
faqs.a: Rankings are calculated strictly from our four weighted user metrics (speed, price value, IP cleanliness, and support). Providers with aggressive affiliate payouts but high CAPTCHA rates rank lower.
